Clans.name: Bruzah
Clans.desc: Philosopher-kings and rebels driven by fiery passion.

Clans.name: Ventrue
Clans.desc: The kings of Kindred society, obsessed with lineage and control.

Clans.name: Gangrel
Clans.desc: Nomadic and feral, attuned to the wilderness and survival.

Clans.name: Malkavian
Clans.desc: Mad seers and prophets, cursed with insight and insanity.

Clans.name: Nosferatu
Clans.desc: Hideous and secretive, masters of stealth and information.

Clans.name: Toreador
Clans.desc: Artists and aesthetes, captivated by beauty and passion.

Clans.name: Tremere
Clans.desc: Scholars of blood magic, seeking power through arcane knowledge.

Clans.name: Lasombra
Clans.desc: Shadow manipulators, leaders of the Sabbat sect.

Clans.name: Assamite
Clans.desc: Deadly assassins, feared for their skill and ruthlessness.

Clans.name: Giovanni
Clans.desc: Necromancers and financiers, masters of death and commerce.

Clans.name: Ravnos
Clans.desc: Tricksters and wanderers, known for their illusions and nomadic lifestyle.

Clans.name: Followers of Set
Clans.desc: Cultists of the serpent god, corrupting others with their influence.

Clans.name: Salubri
Clans.desc: Healers and mystics, rare and often hunted by other Kindred.

Clans.name: Thinbloods
Clans.desc: The lowest caste of vampires, often struggling to survive and find their place in Kindred society.

Clans.name: Hecata
Clans.desc: A clan of necromancers and death-worshippers, formed from the union of the Giovanni and the Salubri.

Clans.name: Independent
Clans.desc: Vampires who do not belong to any clan, often forging their own path in the world.

Predator Types.name: Alleycat
Predator Types.desc: You take what you need by force or threat.

Predator Types.name: Scene Queen
Predator Types.desc: You thrive in social settings, using charm and influence to feed.

Predator Types.name: Siren
Predator Types.desc: You use your allure and charm to captivate and feed on your victims.

powers.name: Cat's Grace
powers.desc: Automatically keep your balance on narrow surfaces.

powers.name: Rapid Reflexes
powers.desc: React to danger with preternatural speed.

powers.name: Lethal Body
powers.desc: Your unarmed strikes can be deadly.

powers.name: Command
powers.desc: Issue a simple command to a target.

powers.name: Mesmerize
powers.desc: Make a target forget something or someone.

powers.name: Vanish
powers.desc: Disappear from sight for a short time.

powers.name: Heightened Senses
powers.desc: Gain enhanced senses to perceive the world around you.

powers.name: Aura Perception
powers.desc: See the auras of living beings, revealing their emotions and intentions.

powers.name: Blood Bond
powers.desc: Create a mystical bond with another being through blood.

powers.name: Blood Puppet
powers.desc: Control a target's actions by manipulating their blood.

powers.name: Dread Gaze
powers.desc: Instill fear in a target with your gaze.

powers.name: Entrancement
powers.desc: Captivate a target, making them more susceptible to your influence.

powers.name: Feral Whispers
powers.desc: Communicate with animals and command them.

powers.name: Beastial Strength
powers.desc: Gain the strength of a wild animal.
